content.value: Given $A = \left[ { \begin{array} { l l } { 3 } & { 2 } \\ { - 1 } & { 2 } \end{array} } \right]$ express matrix A as a linear combination of elementary matrices.(17) [CO4]
i) Identify each of the elementary matrices obtained above, specifying whether they represent scaling, shear, rotation, or another transformation

ii) Sequentially apply the left multiplication of the elementary matrices (derived from matrix A) on the geometric object ABCD whose corner points are $A ( 0 , 0 )$ to B(4, 0), C(2, 4) and $D ( 0 , 2 )$ . Draw initial and all the modified figures of the given dbject ABCD. If the order of the elementary matrices obtained from A is interchanged, and if you apply the transformations again to ABCD, do you obtain the same result as before? justify your answer.
iii) Additionally, apply the left multiplication of A directly on the object ABCD. Draw the figure after the transformation is applied to ABCD.
